nodes.title: Bigger Tanks
nodes.blurb: Twice the propellant in one part.

nodes.title: Launch Pad II
nodes.blurb: A stronger pad for bigger rockets, and side clamps for boosters, one of them feeding the core.

nodes.title: Vacuum Engines
nodes.blurb: A light engine for upper stages above the air.

nodes.title: Re-entry
nodes.blurb: A heat shield for coming home, and a parachute for the side of a stack.

nodes.title: Attitude Control
nodes.blurb: Thrusters that turn a craft where fins can't, and slide it into a dock.

nodes.title: Landing Gear
nodes.blurb: Legs, for setting down on engines where no parachute can help.

nodes.title: Broad Rocketry
nodes.blurb: 2.5 m tanks, the Forge engine, and parts to join them.

nodes.title: Grand Rocketry
nodes.blurb: 3.75 m tanks, the Anvil engine, and parts to join them. Enough to lift a base module.

nodes.title: Launch Pad III
nodes.blurb: Room for a Moon rocket, with a three-seat capsule, its heat shield, and a 2.5 m vacuum engine.

nodes.title: Fairings
nodes.blurb: A shell for whatever the air would tear off.

nodes.title: Docking
nodes.blurb: Ports that join two craft in orbit into one.

nodes.title: Launch Pad IV
nodes.blurb: No limit but what the engines will lift.

nodes.title: Hot Worlds
nodes.blurb: The Hotshell, to keep a lander alive on the hottest, densest worlds.

nodes.title: Flight Computer
nodes.blurb: Auto-burn and auto-land, once you've landed on another world yourself.

nodes.title: Electrics
nodes.blurb: Sun panels, a battery, and a light.

nodes.title: Power
nodes.blurb: Fold-out sun wings, and fuel cells for the night side.

nodes.title: Probes
nodes.blurb: A craft with nobody aboard, flown by radio.

nodes.title: Relays
nodes.blurb: A dish that passes a signal on.

nodes.title: Deep Space
nodes.blurb: The Great Dish, and a generator that needs no sun.

nodes.title: Survey
nodes.blurb: A scanner that maps a world's ore and ice from orbit.

nodes.title: Mining
nodes.blurb: Drill the ground, and refine what comes up into propellant.

nodes.title: Outposts
nodes.blurb: A base to found, with living space, power, lights, and girders, beams and decks to build with.

nodes.title: Industry
nodes.blurb: A base that refines, stores, and launches.

nodes.title: Flight
nodes.blurb: An airfield, a cockpit, the Zephyr jet and swept wings. That's enough for the Sparrow.

nodes.title: Airframes
nodes.blurb: Straight wings, elevons, a tailcone and a frugal propeller for long flights.

nodes.title: Cruise Control
nodes.blurb: Holds an aircraft's height and heading, once you've flown a long way by hand.

nodes.title: Rotorcraft
nodes.blurb: A rotor head, a tail rotor, a boom and skids, and a bubble cockpit: a helicopter.

nodes.title: Drones
nodes.blurb: Small electric rotors and a frame to put four of them on.

nodes.title: Station Keeping
nodes.blurb: The keeper core, to hold a craft still in the air or on the water, once you've hovered by hand.

nodes.title: Balloons
nodes.blurb: A gas balloon with a basket, and gas cells to float bigger things.

nodes.title: Airships
nodes.blurb: A long envelope for an airship, and lift fans to steer a floating platform.

nodes.title: Sky Platforms
nodes.blurb: A deck that floats on light gas, with a pad on top, to found as a base in the sky.

nodes.title: Spaceplanes
nodes.blurb: A cockpit and wing for flying to space and gliding home.

nodes.title: Rovers
nodes.blurb: A chassis, wheels, and an open seat.

nodes.title: Haulers
nodes.blurb: A closed cab, a heavy chassis, a hitch to tow with, and a winch.

nodes.title: Boats
nodes.blurb: A harbour, hulls, an outboard, water jets, a jet ski saddle and a mooring clamp.

nodes.title: Sails
nodes.blurb: A sloop rig for small boats and a cutter rig for big ones.

nodes.title: Ships
nodes.blurb: Hull sections, a wheelhouse, and a keel to stand up to a sea.

nodes.title: Big Ships
nodes.blurb: 4.5 m ship hulls, a diesel or electric drive, a ship's rudder and batteries, and a boarding ladder.

nodes.title: Tall Ships
nodes.blurb: A schooner rig, a square rig, and a deep keel to carry them.

nodes.title: Barges
nodes.blurb: 10 m barge sections, a towing winch, tow bitts, and push knees for a tug.

nodes.title: Flight Decks
nodes.blurb: Floating deck tiles for a landing barge or a flat top, with arresting wires, a catapult and a tailhook.

nodes.title: Sea Platforms
nodes.blurb: Pontoons and a sea deck, for a base afloat with a pad on top.

nodes.title: Submersibles
nodes.blurb: A steel sphere, a trim tank, a screw and dive planes, to go 300 m down.

nodes.title: Sonar
nodes.blurb: The depth under the keel, and which way the sea's named places lie.

nodes.title: Deep Hulls
nodes.blurb: A two-seat hull with tanks and cells to match, to go 1.5 km down.

nodes.title: Sea Floor Bases
nodes.blurb: A footing to hold a base on the sea floor, and a float to get it there.

nodes.title: Abyssal Hulls
nodes.blurb: Titanium and foam, for the floor of the deepest trench.

nodes.title: Crew Quarters
nodes.blurb: Room for eight.

nodes.title: Astronaut Corps
nodes.blurb: Room for sixteen.
